tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti/tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi lam rim ngo mtshar snang ba zhes bya ba/bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yong
༄༅/ /oṃ swasti/tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi lam rim ngo mtshar snang ba zhes bya ba/bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yong

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// oṃ swasti/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi lam rim ngo mtshar snang ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs rdzogs shing*// phrin las 'od dkar phyogs bcur rab rgyas te// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa kun sel ba// thub dbang skyob pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// shes rab mchog tu gyur par rab bsngags shing*// legs par sbyangs pa'i blo gros chu 'dzin las// yang dag rig pa'i glog 'od rab 'khyug pa// phyogs kyi glang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i stobs kyis phas kyi rgol ba bzlog /yang dag rig pas mi rigs tshar gcod cing*// chos min smra ba ring du spong mdzad pa// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ring du brtags kyang rtog par dka' ba'i don// tshad ma'i ring lugs man ngag gnad bsdus pa'i// yang dag rig lam ngo mtshar phul byung ba// skyon bral ngag gi rnam par bshad par bya// 'dir skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byed pa'i lam gyi rim pa tshang la ma nor ba 'di lta ste/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyis lam gyi gzhi bzung*/ lam gyi dngos gzhi thabs shes gnyis bsgom pa'i tshul/ de las thob pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa'o// dang po la/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa// ston pa bde gshegs skyob la phyag 'tshal te// zhes gsungs pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul dang*/ skyabs 'gro dngos bstan la/ 'gro la phan bzhed pa zhes pas sems bskyed bstan/ ston pa dang*/ bde gshegs dang*/ skyob pa gsum gyis lam gyi 'bras bu bstan pa yin no// slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos lam gyi dngos gzhi rgyas pa ni/ brgyad stong don bsdu bar bstan la/ ji snyed pa'i cha ni mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel pa gnad kyi sgron mer bstan no// dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i bzhed tshul ni/ rtog pa'i drwa ba rnams bsal zhing*// zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gis skyabs 'gro bstan la/

sgrub byed thugs rje goms las// zhes pas sems bskyed bstan no// gnyis pa lam gyi dngos gzhi thabs shes gnyis bsgom tshul la/ thabs ni/ rnam pa du mar thabs mang po// yun ring dus su goms pa las// de la skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu gsal ba nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ thabs kyi khyad par du ma bstan/ 'o na las sgrib dag pa'i thabs su gzungs sgrub dang*/ bsnyung gnas dang*/ sbyin sreg dang*/ dka' thub la sogs byas pas/ sdig sgrib rtsa ba nas 'dag gam snyam pa'i log rtog sel ba'i phyir du/ las zad dub pa don med yin// zhes gsungs so// 'o na thabs kyi char gyur pa'i byams sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas nyon mongs kyi sa bon rtsa ba nas gcod nus sam snyam pa'i log rtog sel ba'i phyir du/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// shin tu nyes pa tshar gcod min// zhes sogs gsungs so// 'o na bden bzhi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug po gang rung re bsgoms pas nyon mongs kyi sa bon rtsa ba nas gcod nus sam snyam pa'i log rtog sel ba la/ dngos kyi gnyen po stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/ de'i yan lag tsam du thabs kyi cha dgos pa'i tshul ni/ stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi// sgom pa lhag med de'i don yin// zhes gsungs so// 'o na stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta ba rgyud la ji ltar bskyed snyam na/ dang por gang zag gi bdag gis stong pa'i stong nyid bsgom dgos la/ de la yang thog mar bdag 'dzin gyi yul bdag med par thos bsam gyis gtan la phab dgos te/ 'di'i yul sun dbyung med par ni// de spong ba ni nus ma yin// zhes gsungs so// ci'i phyir thog mar gang zag gi bdag med bsgom dgos snyam na/ nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba bdag 'dzin yin te/ nyes pa rnam pa thams cad dag /'jigs tshogs lta las skyes pa yin// de ma rig dang de la chags// de las zhe sdang la sogs 'byung*// de nyid kyis na nyes rnams kyi// rgyu ni gti mug yin par gsungs// zhes gsungs so// ci'i phyir bdag 'dzin gyi dngos kyi gnyen por bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba bsgom dgos snyam na/

bdag med bdag dang 'gal bas na// bdag med rtogs pas de sun 'byin// zhes gsungs so// 'o na gang zag gi bdag gis stong pa'i stong nyid bsgom pa 'ba' zhig gis chog gam snyam na/ chos kyi bdag gis stong pa'i stong nyid kyang bsgom dgos par bstan pa ni/ ji lta ji ltar don bsam pa// de lta de ltar rnam bral zhes// mkhas pa rnams kyis gang gsungs pa// de ni dngos stobs 'ongs pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de'i don la dpyod par byed pa'i rig pa ni/ gang gis dngos po rnam dpyad na// de nyid du na de dngos med// gang gi phyir na de dag la// gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin med// ces gsungs pas bstan no// de la rtsod pa spong ba ni/ gzung 'dzin tha dad du dngos su snang ba dang 'gal lo snyam na/ blo dag rnam par dbyer med kyang*// mthong ba phyin ci log rnams kyis// gzung dang 'dzin pa myong ba dag /tha dad ldan zhing rtogs par 'gyur// dper na dbang po sngags sogs kyis// bslad pa rnams la 'jim dum sogs// de yi gzugs dang bral ba yang*// rnam pa gzhan du snang ba bzhin// de dag ma bslad mig can gyis// de ltar mthong ba med phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa 'dis gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba de phyin ci log tu snang ba dpes bstan pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med du bsgom dgos par bstan no// gal te gzung 'dzin gnyis med du bsgoms kyang*/ thog ma med pa nas gnyis snang gi bag chags goms pas// rtog pa slar log go snyam na mi bzlog ste/ 'bad du zin kyang mi bzlog ste/ blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa de las thob pa'i 'bras bu ni/ de ldan bcom ldan tshad ma nyid// ces gsungs shing*/ rnam nges las kyang*/ 'khrul pa dben zhing dri ma dang bral ba las bzlog pa med par don dam pa'i tshad ma mngon du byed do zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi don la rtse gcig tu 'bad par bya'o// yang dag rig pas thar lam gsal mdzad pa// mdo dang rnam 'grel mdzad pa'i dgongs pa bzhin// tshad ma'i lam rim ngo mtshar phul byung ba// rong ston bstan pa'i nyi mas gsal bar byas// rnam dkar dge ba 'od stong ldan pa des// phan bde'i pad tshal kun nas rab rgyas shing*// 'gro ba'i blo mun mtha' dag rab bsal te// tshad med thar pa'i gling der myur bgrod shog

/ces tshad ma lam rim gyi ngo mtshar snang ba zhes bya ba 'di rong ston chen pos me mo yos kyi lo la dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
